description: mods (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1): the kairos button in the prompt footer, the model's own compact tool (offered with the context figures after the turn's end as a prompt the plugin submits, a turn of its own, from 300k tokens on and once per 70k of growth; compaction at the end of the turn that asked, then the resume prompt it wrote), the auto-mode appeal, the interim-notification filter, and the plugin reload (a plugin update another process installed applies in the running session: /reload-plugins once it is idle, its rows emptied for the model and its output a transcript line for the person; one session per machine fetches the autoUpdate marketplaces every 5 minutes and installs what moved). The ask tool, the bridge and the session's sminos address are the sminos plugin's. to-human-stream.sh (MessageDisplay) draws the <message> mark while a message streams (the report view that folds the transcript to those marks is the to-human plugin); old <to-human>, <essential>, <need-input> and <insight> marks read as aliases of it. kairos: proactive mode — on from launch with KAIROS=1 or mid-session with /kairos, kept across compaction and resume; /kairos off ends it. compact-instructions.md: PreCompact prints it, so every compaction's summary is written as the note a memory-reset self resumes from
